segments.text: In the previous tutorial we learned about filtration, a technique that allows us to separate
segments.zh: 在上一期教程中，我们学习了过滤，这项技术可以让我们分离

segments.text: solid and liquid components of a mixture.
segments.zh: 混合物中的固体和液体组分。

segments.text: But what if the components we wish to separate are both in solution?
segments.zh: 但如果我们想分离的组分都在溶液中呢？

segments.text: There is nothing about particle size that will allow us to do so.
segments.zh: 颗粒大小方面没有任何特点能让我们做到这一点。

segments.text: Fortunately, there are separation techniques in chemistry that take advantage of factors
segments.zh: 幸运的是，化学中有一些分离技术利用的是

segments.text: other than particle size in order to separate components.
segments.zh: 颗粒大小以外的因素来分离组分。

segments.text: These focus on properties such as solubility, polarity, and reactivity.
segments.zh: 这些技术着眼于溶解度、极性和反应性等性质。

segments.text: The technique we will go over in this tutorial is called extraction.
segments.zh: 我们在本期教程中要讲的技术叫做萃取。

segments.text: Extraction is a technique that uses a two-phase system to separate mixtures.
segments.zh: 萃取是一种利用两相体系来分离混合物的技术。

segments.text: The most common form is a liquid-liquid extraction, and in this context, the two-phase system
segments.zh: 最常见的形式是液液萃取，在这种情况下，两相体系

segments.text: will be an organic phase and an aqueous phase.
segments.zh: 就是有机相和水相。

segments.text: So in performing this technique, we will separate a desired compound from a mixture
segments.zh: 所以在进行这项技术时，我们会通过把目标化合物

segments.text: by moving it from one solvent to another.
segments.zh: 从一种溶剂转移到另一种溶剂中，把它从混合物中分离出来。

segments.text: To perform this technique, we will be taking the solution and adding a new solvent that
segments.zh: 要进行这项技术，我们会取溶液，加入一种新的溶剂，

segments.text: dissolves and isolates one compound from the mixture.
segments.zh: 它能溶解并从混合物中分离出一种化合物。

segments.text: We must use a solvent that is immiscible with the first solvent, so that separate layers
segments.zh: 我们必须使用与第一种溶剂互不相溶的溶剂，这样才会

segments.text: will form, as this makes it quite easy to separate them.
segments.zh: 形成分开的液层，因为这样分离起来就相当容易。

segments.text: To do this, we'll need a separatory funnel.
segments.zh: 为此，我们需要一个分液漏斗。

segments.text: This is a tool that is used to separate two immiscible liquids of different densities.
segments.zh: 这是一种用来分离两种密度不同、互不相溶的液体的工具。

segments.text: Once again, in most cases, the two liquids will be an organic solvent, plus whatever compounds
segments.zh: 同样，在大多数情况下，这两种液体一种是有机溶剂，加上溶解在其中的

segments.text: are dissolved in it, and then water, plus whatever compounds are dissolved in it.
segments.zh: 各种化合物，另一种是水，加上溶解在其中的各种化合物。

segments.text: It is usually the case that the aqueous layer has a greater density than the organic layer,
segments.zh: 通常情况下，水层的密度比有机层大，

segments.text: so it goes to the bottom while the organic solvent stays on top, as gravity will pull
segments.zh: 所以水层沉在下面，而有机溶剂留在上面，因为重力会以更大的力

segments.text: the denser layer down with greater force.
segments.zh: 把密度较大的那层往下拉。

segments.text: However, some organic solvents are more dense than water and will thus occupy the
segments.zh: 不过，有些有机溶剂的密度比水大，因此会处于

segments.text: bottom layer, so it is important to consult a table of densities to be sure as to
segments.zh: 下层，所以查阅密度表来确认

segments.text: which layer is which.
segments.zh: 哪一层是哪一层很重要。

segments.text: When in doubt, if you want to identify which layer is which, add a bit of water.
segments.zh: 拿不准的时候，如果你想确认哪一层是哪一层，就加一点水。

segments.text: Whichever layer grows, that's the aqueous layer.
segments.zh: 哪一层变多了，哪一层就是水层。

segments.text: Now let's get more familiar with the intricacies of the separatory funnel.
segments.zh: 现在我们来更深入地熟悉分液漏斗的细节。

segments.text: As we can see here, the funnel has a stopper at the top, and a stopcock at the bottom.
segments.zh: 我们在这里可以看到，漏斗顶部有一个塞子，底部有一个旋塞。

segments.text: This middle region is where our separation will take place.
segments.zh: 中间这个区域就是进行分离的地方。

segments.text: To get this ready, you might have to add a little bit of grease to the stopper and
segments.zh: 准备时，你可能需要给塞子和／

segments.text: or stopcock, since they tend to get stuck.
segments.zh: 或旋塞涂一点润滑脂，因为它们容易卡住。

segments.text: To set up for the extraction, we'll start with a ring stand attached to a support like
segments.zh: 为萃取做准备，我们先把一个铁圈像这样固定在支架

segments.text: this.
segments.zh: 上。

segments.text: We'll then place our separatory funnel in the ring and make sure everything is secure.
segments.zh: 然后把分液漏斗放进铁圈里，确保一切都牢固。

segments.text: To verify that the stopcock works, add some water.
segments.zh: 为了确认旋塞能正常工作，加一些水。

segments.text: Make sure there are no leaks when the valve is closed.
segments.zh: 确保阀门关闭时没有泄漏。

segments.text: Open the valve to see how the water flows.
segments.zh: 打开阀门，看看水是怎么流出来的。

segments.text: Once satisfied, remove the water.
segments.zh: 确认没问题后，把水倒掉。

segments.text: We are now ready to get started.
segments.zh: 现在我们可以开始了。

segments.text: So let's say this is a reaction mixture that we just got from performing a chemical
segments.zh: 假设这是我们刚刚在某种有机溶剂中进行化学

segments.text: reaction in some organic solvent.
segments.zh: 反应得到的反应混合物。

segments.text: Most of the time you'll need to quench a reaction once it's finished by adding water.
segments.zh: 大多数时候，反应结束后你需要加水来淬灭反应。

segments.text: This means to stop a reaction mixture from reacting further, often with dilute weak acid
segments.zh: 意思是让反应混合物不再继续反应，通常用稀的弱酸

segments.text: or base, to neutralize any ionic species.
segments.zh: 或弱碱，来中和任何离子物种。

segments.text: This means that after any chemical reaction, you will need to perform an extraction to
segments.zh: 这意味着在任何化学反应之后，你都需要进行萃取，

segments.text: separate your organic compounds from whatever is in the aqueous layer.
segments.zh: 把你的有机化合物与水层中的东西分开。

segments.text: In this particular case, rather than a reaction mixture, we simply have a mixture containing
segments.zh: 在这个具体的例子中，我们用的不是反应混合物，而只是一份含有

segments.text: benzoic acid and 2-methoxy naphthalene dissolved in diethyl ether, and our goal is to obtain
segments.zh: 苯甲酸和 2-甲氧基萘、溶解在乙醚中的混合物，我们的目标是得到

segments.text: each of these two compounds in a pure form.
segments.zh: 这两种化合物各自的纯净形式。

segments.text: These are both soluble in diethyl ether, but insoluble in water.
segments.zh: 它们都溶于乙醚，但不溶于水。

segments.text: However, if we add aqueous base to this mixture, benzoic acid will deprotonate, becoming
segments.zh: 不过，如果我们往这个混合物里加入碱的水溶液，苯甲酸就会脱去质子，变成

segments.text: the benzoate anion, which has a formal negative charge, and will thus become water soluble
segments.zh: 苯甲酸根阴离子，它带有一个形式负电荷，因此会变得水溶，

segments.text: and move into the aqueous phase.
segments.zh: 并转移到水相中。

segments.text: Since 2-methoxy naphthalene will not react, that will remain in the organic phase, and
segments.zh: 由于 2-甲氧基萘不会发生反应，它会留在有机相中，这样

segments.text: the two compounds will have separated.
segments.zh: 两种化合物就分开了。

segments.text: With our strategy understood, we can begin performing the technique.
segments.zh: 理解了策略之后，我们就可以开始操作了。

segments.text: Making sure that the stopcock is closed, let's transfer our mixture to the separatory
segments.zh: 确保旋塞是关着的，我们用一个锥形玻璃漏斗把混合物转移到分液

segments.text: funnel using a conical glass funnel.
segments.zh: 漏斗中。

segments.text: This is our organic layer.
segments.zh: 这是我们的有机层。

segments.text: To make sure we have transferred everything, rinse the beaker that held the mixture with
segments.zh: 为了确保把所有东西都转移过去，用乙醚冲洗盛放混合物的烧杯，

segments.text: ether and transfer that as well.
segments.zh: 也一并转移过去。

segments.text: Had this been the product of a chemical reaction, it would already have been quenched and thus
segments.zh: 如果这是一个化学反应的产物，它应该已经被淬灭，因而

segments.text: have formed organic and aqueous layers.
segments.zh: 已经形成了有机层和水层。

segments.text: But since we are just doing an isolated extraction, let's go ahead and perform the necessary
segments.zh: 但由于我们只是做一个单独的萃取，那就直接在分液漏斗里

segments.text: acid base reaction right in the separatory funnel.
segments.zh: 进行所需的酸碱反应。

segments.text: To separate benzoic acid from the mixture, we will add 30 milliliters of 1 molar sodium
segments.zh: 为了把苯甲酸从混合物中分离出来，我们往分液漏斗中加入 30 毫升 1 摩尔每升的氢氧化钠

segments.text: hydroxide to the separatory funnel.
segments.zh: 溶液。

segments.text: This will pass through the organic layer, react with benzoic acid on the way to form
segments.zh: 它会穿过有机层，途中与苯甲酸反应生成

segments.text: sodium benzoate, and drag that down to the newly forming aqueous layer on the bottom.
segments.zh: 苯甲酸钠，并把它带到下面新形成的水层中。

segments.text: To make sure the reaction goes to completion, we need to mix the contents of the funnel.
segments.zh: 为确保反应完全，我们需要把漏斗里的东西混合均匀。

segments.text: We will do this by inverting it and lightly swirling a few times, holding the stopper down
segments.zh: 做法是把漏斗倒转过来，轻轻旋摇几次，同时用一根手指

segments.text: with one finger as we do so to ensure that nothing spills out.
segments.zh: 按住塞子，确保没有东西洒出来。

segments.text: Mix for about 10 seconds each time.
segments.zh: 每次混合大约 10 秒。

segments.text: After each round of mixing, hold the funnel upside down and open the stopcock like this
segments.zh: 每轮混合之后，把漏斗倒过来拿着，像这样打开旋塞，

segments.text: to vent any gases that accumulate from the reaction.
segments.zh: 放掉反应中积聚的任何气体。

segments.text: Close it, and then continue mixing.
segments.zh: 关上旋塞，然后继续混合。

segments.text: When gases are vented, you will hear a brief hissing sound.
segments.zh: 放气时，你会听到短暂的嘶嘶声。

segments.text: When the sound no longer occurs, no more gas is being produced, and we can be confident
segments.zh: 当不再听到这种声音时，就说明不再产生气体，我们就可以确信

segments.text: that mixing is complete.
segments.zh: 混合已经完成。

segments.text: After mixing, it is time to separate.
segments.zh: 混合之后，就该分离了。

segments.text: Return your separatory funnel to the ring support and allow the contents to settle.
segments.zh: 把分液漏斗放回铁圈支架上，让里面的液体静置分层。

segments.text: You should see the two layers separate clearly.
segments.zh: 你应该会看到两层清楚地分开。

segments.text: You can now open the stopcock to let the bottom layer drop into a clean flask.
segments.zh: 现在你可以打开旋塞，让下层流入一个干净的烧瓶中。

segments.text: This is where you have to be careful.
segments.zh: 这里你必须小心。

segments.text: Watch the aqueous layer drip slowly so that you can stop it right before any of the top
segments.zh: 看着水层慢慢滴下，这样你就能在上层

segments.text: layer goes through.
segments.zh: 流出之前及时停住。

segments.text: When the line separating the layers reaches the stopcock, close it.
segments.zh: 当两层之间的分界线到达旋塞时，关上旋塞。

segments.text: You have now separated the two layers.
segments.zh: 现在你已经把两层分开了。

segments.text: The top layer can be removed by pouring it through the top of the funnel into a
segments.zh: 上层可以从漏斗顶部倒进

segments.text: separate flask.
segments.zh: 另一个烧瓶中移走。

segments.text: Be sure to pour it out the top and not through the stopcock, as pouring out the bottom would
segments.zh: 一定要从顶部倒出，而不是从旋塞放出，因为从底部放出

segments.text: contaminate it.
segments.zh: 会污染它。

segments.text: With most extractions, we will need to do more than one separation so as to maximize
segments.zh: 大多数萃取都需要进行不止一次分离，以便

segments.text: your yield, as not all of the benzoic acid made it out of the organic layer.
segments.zh: 最大限度地提高产率，因为并不是所有的苯甲酸都离开了有机层。

segments.text: So let's put this first aqueous extract to the side.
segments.zh: 所以我们先把第一次的水相萃取液放在一边。

segments.text: Return the organic layer to the separatory funnel, and make sure everything is secured.
segments.zh: 把有机层倒回分液漏斗中，并确保一切都牢固。

segments.text: We can then add more aqueous base to the organic layer, and mix just as we did before.
segments.zh: 然后我们可以往有机层中再加入一些碱的水溶液，像之前一样混合。

segments.text: Allow the layers to separate, and we can now collect the bottom layer again, adding it
segments.zh: 让两层分开，现在我们可以再次收集下层，把它加到

segments.text: to the original extract.
segments.zh: 最初的萃取液中。

segments.text: So now the extraction itself is complete.
segments.zh: 现在萃取本身就完成了。

segments.text: We have some aqueous sodium benzoate, and then we have two methoxy naphthalene still
segments.zh: 我们得到了一些苯甲酸钠水溶液，而 2-甲氧基萘仍然

segments.text: in the organic solvent.
segments.zh: 在有机溶剂中。

segments.text: Let's isolate this first.
segments.zh: 我们先把它分离出来。

segments.text: The organic layer will likely contain residual water from the multiple washes that we performed.
segments.zh: 由于我们进行了多次洗涤，有机层中很可能含有残留的水。

segments.text: How do we get it out?
segments.zh: 我们怎样把水除掉呢？

segments.text: We use a drying agent.
segments.zh: 我们用干燥剂。

segments.text: A drying agent is a compound like sodium sulfate that removes water when added to a solution.
segments.zh: 干燥剂是一种像硫酸钠这样的化合物，加入溶液后能除去水。

segments.text: The water should bind to the drying agent, and thus join the solid phase.
segments.zh: 水会与干燥剂结合，从而进入固相。

segments.text: Keep adding the drying agent until you see a clear solution with all of the solid clumped
segments.zh: 不断加入干燥剂，直到你看到溶液澄清，所有固体都结块

segments.text: at the bottom.
segments.zh: 沉在底部。

segments.text: You will know it's dry when lightly shaking the flask does not cause any solid to move
segments.zh: 当轻轻摇动烧瓶时，没有任何固体在溶液中四处移动，

segments.text: around the solution.
segments.zh: 你就知道已经干燥好了。

segments.text: To separate the drying agent from the liquid, we'll need to do a gravity filtration.
segments.zh: 要把干燥剂和液体分开，我们需要做一次常压过滤。

segments.text: Since we discussed this at great length in the previous tutorial, we won't go over
segments.zh: 由于我们在上一期教程中已经详细讨论过，这里就不再

segments.text: the details here, but set up your filtration, and pour your dried organic layer in.
segments.zh: 赘述细节，只需搭好过滤装置，把干燥后的有机层倒进去。

segments.text: The drying agent will remain on the filter paper, and the target molecule will move
segments.zh: 干燥剂会留在滤纸上，而目标分子会随溶剂

segments.text: through with the solvent.
segments.zh: 一起流过去。

segments.text: Make sure to rinse the flask with more solvent so that everything is transferred.
segments.zh: 一定要用更多的溶剂冲洗烧瓶，以便把所有东西都转移过去。

segments.text: Then just evaporate the solvent on a hot plate, as ether is rather volatile, and we will be
segments.zh: 然后只需在加热板上把溶剂蒸发掉，因为乙醚相当易挥发，我们就会

segments.text: left with a residue of pure 2-methoxy naphthalene.
segments.zh: 得到纯净的 2-甲氧基萘残留物。

segments.text: The aqueous layer will be a bit trickier, as we wanted to isolate benzoic acid, but
segments.zh: 水层要稍微麻烦一些，因为我们想分离的是苯甲酸，但

segments.text: here we have sodium benzoate.
segments.zh: 这里得到的是苯甲酸钠。

segments.text: To get benzoic acid, we will need to do another acid-base reaction to protonate the
segments.zh: 要得到苯甲酸，我们需要再做一次酸碱反应，使

segments.text: benzoate.
segments.zh: 苯甲酸根质子化。

segments.text: Let's add about 5 mL of 6-molar hydrochloric acid.
segments.zh: 我们加入大约 5 mL 6 摩尔每升的盐酸。

segments.text: You may need to add a little more than this, just monitor the solution with litmus paper
segments.zh: 你可能需要多加一点，只要用石蕊试纸监测溶液，

segments.text: and add it until the solution starts to turn acidic.
segments.zh: 一直加到溶液开始变成酸性。

segments.text: A pH of around 2 means that the acid is no longer neutralizing base, but is turning the
segments.zh: pH 大约为 2，意味着酸不再是在中和碱，而是在使

segments.text: solution acidic, which means the acid is in excess and the reaction is complete.
segments.zh: 溶液变成酸性，这说明酸已经过量，反应已经完全。

segments.text: As benzoic acid forms, it will begin to precipitate.
segments.zh: 随着苯甲酸的生成，它会开始沉淀出来。

segments.text: If this is happening very slowly, the flask can be placed in an ice bath or cold water
segments.zh: 如果这个过程非常慢，可以把烧瓶放在冰浴或冷水

segments.text: bath to encourage solid formation.
segments.zh: 浴中，促进固体的生成。

segments.text: Once precipitation of benzoic acid is complete, it can be collected by vacuum filtration.
segments.zh: 苯甲酸沉淀完全后，可以用真空抽滤把它收集起来。

segments.text: Again, we have described this technique in the previous tutorial, so we will not go
segments.zh: 同样，我们在上一期教程中已经介绍过这项技术，所以这里不再

segments.text: into detail here, but collect your solid on the Büchner funnel and allow it to dry
segments.zh: 赘述细节，只需在布氏漏斗上收集固体，让它在实验台上

segments.text: on the bench for some time, then moving it to an oven if further drying is necessary.
segments.zh: 晾干一段时间，如果需要进一步干燥，再把它转移到烘箱中。

segments.text: And with that, we have completed a liquid-liquid extraction.
segments.zh: 这样，我们就完成了一次液液萃取。

segments.text: We had two organic molecules mixed together in an organic solvent, and we separated them
segments.zh: 我们有两种有机分子混合在一种有机溶剂中，我们根据它们的

segments.text: based on their chemical properties, namely their propensity to undergo an acid-base reaction.
segments.zh: 化学性质，也就是它们发生酸碱反应的倾向，把它们分离开来。

segments.text: This is an important tool that is used constantly in organic chemistry.
segments.zh: 这是有机化学中经常使用的一个重要工具。

segments.text: It is also widely used in industry for the extraction of natural products, ranging from
segments.zh: 它在工业上也被广泛用于提取天然产物，范围从

segments.text: caffeine extraction from leaves to metal extraction from minerals.
segments.zh: 从叶子中提取咖啡因，到从矿物中提取金属。

segments.text: With this now understood, let's move forward and check out some other techniques.
segments.zh: 理解了这些之后，我们继续往下，看看其他一些技术。
